# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: This is the inside of the $$バベルの塔$$!!
They have been cursed with immortality,
doomed to have their $$生き血$$ drained forever while they still live—
the $$生贄$$s that sustain this tower!!
Hey, old man! It has been nagging me,
but you know way too much about this!
And you seemed to know that route from the start.
Even before $$天国の門$$, you made a point of not even giving us your name...
